description: Evaluation cases for topic-explorer v7 — story-first brainstorming approach

cases.description: Output must contain a clear research question
cases.prompt: 我想研究AI对产业链价值分配的影响

cases.description: Research question must be explanatory, not merely descriptive
cases.prompt: 我想研究新易盛的价值跃升

cases.description: Proposal must identify a research puzzle / motivating phenomenon
cases.prompt: 帮我选题，方向是数字经济和就业

cases.description: Proposal must contain an explicit story line before being finalised
cases.prompt: 帮我把这个选题做成完整研究方案：AI技术范式变革如何使后发企业实现价值跃升

cases.description: Proposal must state what is out of scope
cases.prompt: 研究成都新易盛的全球价值链升级路径
我想做一个关于光通信企业在AI时代价值跃升的案例研究

cases.description: Complete proposal passes all core checks
cases.prompt: 帮我完成完整的选题分析：AI产业链重构背景下，新易盛为什么能将产业机会转化为价值跃升？

cases.description: Should NOT trigger for pure empirical analysis request
cases.prompt: 运行基准回归并输出结果表格

cases.description: Should NOT trigger for paper-writing request
cases.prompt: 帮我写第三章的案例分析
